# ProksiAbel OÜ

> ProksiAbel OÜ is an EU-based (Estonia) offensive security consultancy specializing in MITM attack defense, web application penetration testing, vulnerability management, and secure development practices. The site is bilingual (Estonian/English).

ProksiAbel OÜ (registry code 17017826) runs hands-on penetration tests of web applications and authentication flows, builds practical countermeasures against MITM attacks and client fingerprinting, and develops custom security research tooling. Services: Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Management, Secure Development Practices, Security Research & Tool Development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://proksiabel.ee/): Services overview, expertise, about, and contact.
- [FIDO2 vs Passkeys: A Technical Guide](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/fido2-vs-passkeys): Protocol-level comparison of FIDO2 (WebAuthn + CTAP2) and passkeys — discoverable credentials, attestation, backup eligibility, and relying-party implementation guidance.
- [SSRF Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/ssrf-explained): Server-side request forgery (SSRF) deep-dive — attack anatomy, cloud metadata credential theft (169.254.169.254), deny-list bypasses, Suricata/Semgrep detection rules, and allowlist-based fix patterns in Python, Go, and Node.js, with a reproducible docker-compose lab.
- [IDOR Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/idor-explained): Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) / broken object level authorization (BOLA) deep-dive — missing object-level authorization, read/write IDOR with a reproducible docker-compose lab, two-account detection methodology, a Semgrep taint rule template, and ownership-check fix patterns in Python, Node.js, and Go.
- [XXE Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/xxe-explained): XML external entity (XXE) injection (CWE-611) deep-dive — the XML 1.0 external-entity features and why entity resolution is optional for non-validating parsers, in-band file disclosure, SSRF and blind out-of-band attack classes, CVE-2025-66516 / CVE-2025-68493 / CVE-2017-12629, a reproducible docker-compose Flask/lxml lab with a vulnerable and a hardened endpoint, Semgrep and Suricata detection rules, and per-language fix patterns in Java, .NET, Python, PHP, Go, and Node.js.
- [Kubernetes Security Best Practices: A Hardening Checklist](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/kubernetes-security-hardening): Kubernetes hardening checklist with copy-paste YAML and verification commands — control-plane and kubelet hardening (anonymous auth, RBAC, secrets encryption at rest), Pod Security Standards enforcement (restricted profile, seccomp, non-root), default-deny NetworkPolicies with DNS rules, RBAC least privilege, image supply-chain gates (scan/pin/sign), kube-bench verification, and the operational trade-off of every control.
- [Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/ssti-explained): Server-side template injection (SSTI) deep-dive — how user input becomes template code (CWE-1336), template-engine fingerprinting probes (Jinja2/Twig/FreeMarker/Velocity/ERB/Mako/Thymeleaf), high-severity real CVEs (vBulletin 2019, VMware 2022, ServiceNow 2024 — all CVSS 9.8), a reproducible docker-compose Flask/Jinja2 lab with a verified RCE chain, a Semgrep taint rule template, and structural fix patterns.
- [Race Conditions Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/race-conditions-explained): Race condition / TOCTOU vulnerabilities (CWE-362, CWE-367) deep-dive — check-then-use race windows, limit overruns and hidden multi-step sub-states, real CVEs, a reproducible docker-compose Flask/SQLite lab (25-for-1 coupon redemption), detection methodology with single-packet attack tooling, and atomic fix patterns in Python, Node.js, and Postgres.
- [Security Headers Checklist: How to Configure and Verify HTTP Security Headers](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/security-headers-checklist): Priority-ordered HTTP security headers checklist — exact values for HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP/COEP, what each header breaks when enabled, config examples (Cloudflare _headers, Nginx, Caddy, Express/helmet), curl-based verification, and a CI gate script.
- [SQL Injection Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/sqli-explained): SQL injection (CWE-89) deep-dive — how string concatenation lets attackers rewrite queries, classic and blind attack classes (boolean/time-based), second-order and out-of-band SQLi, real CVEs including Metabase CVE-2026-72898 (CVSS 10.0), a reproducible docker-compose Flask lab with vulnerable and fixed endpoints, Semgrep taint rules and Suricata network detection rules, and parameterized-query fix patterns in Java, C#, Python, Node.js, and Go.
- [Privacy Policy](https://proksiabel.ee/privacy): How ProksiAbel OÜ handles your data.
- [Terms of Service](https://proksiabel.ee/terms): Terms for the consultancy's services.
- [Cookie Policy](https://proksiabel.ee/cookies): Only essential security cookies; no tracking.
- [Responsible Disclosure](https://proksiabel.ee/disclosure): How to report security vulnerabilities.
